confirmed_observations: The original long prompt was converted into a pasted-text attachment before confirmed submission.
All four executions ended authoritatively interrupted; no output was accepted or fabricated.
The candidate expansion helper reported one Remove pasted text attachment control and zero Show in text field controls on the last two attempts after its bounded wait.

Later read-only CUA inspection saw exactly one enabled Show in text field button and one Remove pasted text attachment button in the composer form. The Show button had exact text, normal visible styles, no hidden/excluded ancestor, and was attached.
Moving existing exec_command before paste did not pass the full text plus send-readiness verification in the final live attempt and therefore fell through to paste.
Browser-effect cancellation from candidate preparation errors was recorded, but canonical turn stayed running until supported explicit interruption.
unresolved: Why the live internal control query/filter observed Show=0 while later read-only CUA observed the exact button is unknown. The evidence does not establish opacity, a rendering race, or a specific selector/filter defect.
The candidate fixture is insufficient to prove compatibility with the current real ChatGPT composer.
A general production recovery method for cancelled-before-send composer failures was not added. Existing narrow busy-before-target acknowledgement remains unchanged.
